objective: One authorized executable on the owner's computer bootstraps and connects the complete CEREBRO access stack without binding the device permanently to one company or one website.
bootstrap_flow: discover authorized companies and target sites
discover available connector/API/MCP surfaces per target
create or reuse least-privilege scoped bindings
store credentials only as protected references
attest identity, tenant scope and environment
leave PROD disabled unless separately promoted
staging_connector_note: The current staging connector is site/environment specific. It may be used to close STAGING acceptance, but the universal design must discover and bind arbitrary authorized sites/companies dynamically rather than baking staging.fenixcapital.es into the device identity or executable.
final_acceptance: dynamic company_id engine_id environment version scope
automatic connector discovery/bootstrap where APIs permit
vault recovery proven without exposing secrets
